scope: Source PBR, smooth split normals and UV; legacy baseline intentionally retained. Native source PBR, geometry and Nanite, including runtime copy. Build settings are recorded, not a final native split-normal comparison.

native_assets.observation: UE rebuilds normals. Source smooth normals are verified, but the final vertex normals are not byte-compared; this flag alone does not prove lost smoothing. Existing same-light UE images show continuous highlights on Polished.
native_assets.specular_scope: Named effective scalar values only; an empty map is not zero specular. Source uses glTF nonmetal dielectric defaults.
